{{Top|leg}}
The '''daggerfly''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the forest [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Prior to the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union's]] experiments on the planet, daggerflies were among the many creatures native to the Metalorn rainforests, but after the tests caused much of the forest to whither or [[Fire/Legends|burn]], the daggerfly was one of the last creatures on the planet. They were covered in [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]], and they ate the small animals that fed on the waste from [[Factory/Legends|factories]] on the world.
